## Restore into an empty database (deploy/restore.sh); over data it refuses
Restored blizz.dump into blizz_restored: 117 migrations applied. Start the server on it with the same ERASURE_JOURNAL_DIR.
Database blizz_restored is not empty (116 tables): restore only into an empty database

In the restored database before the server starts: `ACTIVE +380685194885` (the backup predates the deletion).

## Start the server on the restored database with the same journal: the deletion is applied again

After the start: `ANONYMIZED -`.

Done: backup, restore into an empty database, start on it; the deleted rider stayed deleted (T-39).
